title: Command & Conquer: Red Alert
notes: Mission achievements unlock when the next mission starts loading after a win.
The last mission of each campaign ends the game instead of loading another, so it can't be tracked yet.

testGuide.title: Start Command & Conquer: Red Alert
testGuide.detail: Click Play on the game page and wait for the main menu.

testGuide.title: Start the campaign
testGuide.detail: Start a new game on either side. "Current mission file" should show something like SCG01EA.
